titleEn: Share It in Two, Yum for Both!

pages.text: "Caught it! It's all mine!" On the boat tied by the water, Pongi raised a fish in her paws. The silver fish flapped. Beside her, her brother held his shell and licked his lips.
Her brother held out a paw. "Sis, me too..." Pongi hugged the fish and quickly turned her back. "No! I'm eating it all myself!" The boat rocked gently.

Her brother sat at the far end of the boat with his back turned, playing with his shell. Pongi sat alone with the fish. She was bored. Even one bite didn't taste good. "Oh? Why doesn't it taste good?"

Mom, wearing her headscarf, sat on the side of the boat and leaned toward Pongi. "You caught a fish, Pongi. Why is your mouth drooping?" Pongi tilted her head. "It's all mine... but it doesn't taste good at all."

Mom smiled. "Share something tasty in two, and it's yum for both! Eating together tastes much better." Pongi looked down at the fish. "Will it taste better if I share it?" The fish on her lap gave a flap.
Pongi stood in front of her brother and offered the fish with both paws. "I'm sorry about before. Let's have half each!" He turned to look at her and smiled.
Pongi called, "One, ask, 'Would you like some?' Two, split it in half!" The fish became two pieces. She put one in her brother's paws. "Share it in two, yum for both!" she sang.
"Three, eat together!" said Pongi. They sat side by side on the boat floor and munched. Together, it tasted much better! Her brother smiled. "Yum!" Pongi thumped her tail on the boat floor.
Back home at the table, Pongi split the bread in two. "One, ask, 'Would you like some?' Two, split it in half! Three, eat together!" "Let's eat together!" She offered her brother a piece.

Mom bent her knees and wrapped both paws around Pongi. "You've become a big sister who knows how to share!" Split something tasty, and the smiles double too. Pongi called, "Share it in two, yum for both!"
